**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation you're in and what's missing — not just the feature itself, but why you need it.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd want porthole to do. A rough sketch of the command/flag/UI is helpful but not required.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other way you've found to work around this, and why it's not good enough.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, examples from other tools, etc.
